resources.string:
October Arc and your health data

October Arc reads your step count and sleep sessions from Health Connect only to show your daily progress, streaks and reminders.

• Read-only: October Arc never writes to Health Connect.
• Your data stays on this phone. It is only sent to a server if you turn on sync in Settings, where it is encrypted at rest.
• No ads, analytics or third-party trackers. Your data is never sold or shared.
• You can revoke access at any time in Health Connect, and delete all October Arc data in Settings → Privacy.

October Arc is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.
